# up gofumpt

Pin `gofumpt` at v0.3.1 in the Go toolset, the patch release following [#257](DOT-256.md) (v0.3.0). `gofumpt` is a stricter drop-in for `gofmt`; the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v0.3.1 tag](https://github.com/mvdan/gofumpt/releases/tag/v0.3.1).
